Vs.
Md. Basir Mia and another
full_judgment: 10. Mr. Sheikh Muhammed Serajul Islam, the learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff-petitioner submits that the court of appeal below did not consider the case of the plaintiff as well as the defendants in its proper perspective and gave her verdict on presumption. He further submits that the Court of appeal below misread and misconstrued the evidence on record and thereby committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. He further submits that the Court of appeal below failed to appreciate that the plaintiff-petitioner entered into an agreement for sale and defendant No.1 received an amount of Tk. 75,000/- out of consideration amount of Tk. 87,000/-. He further submits that the appellate Court also failed to consider that on received of the heavy amount the defendant No.1 handed over peaceful possession of the suit property to the plaintiff and after the judgment of reversal by the appellate Court the defendant No.1 is trying to dispossess the plaintiff. He further submits that all the witnesses of the plaintiff proved that the defendant No.1 entered into an agreement for sale of the schedule property and a value was fixed at Tk. 87,000/- and he received Tk.75,000/- and handed over possession. He further submits that the witnesses of the defendant stated that they does not know the suit property and that the trial Court found that the defendant No.1 defrauded the plaintiff and put his signature by changing his name at every stages. He further submits that the defendant No.1 put his signature as মোঃ বসির মিয়া but when he appeared before the trial Court by filing Vokalatnama he has signed as it and when he submitted his written objection he has signed as মোঃ বছির উদ্দিন and when he deposed before the Court of law he has singed as মোঃ বশির মিয়া and as such it appears that the defendant No.1 is a very shrewd person and he wanted to deprive the plaintiff from his rightful claim and that the trial Court on consideration of the signature of the said defendant No.1 decreed the suit but the appellate Court without considering the said signature reversed the judgment and decree of the trial Court without considering any evidences on record thereby committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. He further submits that the said defendant No.1 filed his Vokalatnama before the High Court Division writing as মোঃ বছির and that the defendant No.1 admitted his signature over the stamp paper in the written statement and deposition.
